variables.systemDescription: The PlayStation 5 (PS5) is a home video game console developed by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Announced as the successor to the PlayStation 4 in April 2019, it was launched on November 12, 2020, in Australia, Japan, New Zealand, North America, and South Korea, and November 19, 2020, in the rest of the world. A console of the ninth generation, it competes with Microsoft's Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch.
